The '''Monks Well''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was known primarily to locals around [[Mos Espa]], but was obscure enough that offworlders were generally unfamiliar with it. During a search for her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her companions discounted Monk’s Well as a possible destination, reasoning that Han would not have known about the location.<ref name="Ghost" />
